name: pubquiz
description: Self-hosted live pub quiz. Teams join from their phones by QR code.

scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:slow
scripts.test:fast: PUBQUIZ_POINTS_UNIT=1000 PUBQUIZ_SCORING_DEFAULT=speed PUBQUIZ_ADMISSION_DEFAULT=off PUBQUIZ_PHONES_ONLY_DEFAULT=off PUBQUIZ_READOUT_DEFAULT=off node --test --test-timeout=60000 --test-force-exit "test/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:slow: PUBQUIZ_POINTS_UNIT=1000 PUBQUIZ_SCORING_DEFAULT=speed PUBQUIZ_ADMISSION_DEFAULT=off PUBQUIZ_PHONES_ONLY_DEFAULT=off PUBQUIZ_READOUT_DEFAULT=off node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-force-exit "test/slow/*.test.ts"
